name: @platform/api
description: Modular monolith API and workers for the platform and its products (one database per module).

scripts.db:generate: node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma generate --schema prisma/platform/schema.prisma && node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma generate --schema prisma/invoicing/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/platform/schema.prisma && node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/invoicing/schema.prisma && pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:reset: node ../../scripts/guard-destructive-db.mjs && node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed --schema prisma/platform/schema.prisma && node ../../scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed --schema prisma/invoicing/schema.prisma && pnpm db:seed
